intent.raw_query: Patagonia hiking Torres del Paine, $4500, 12 days, December

experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hike
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route through Torres del Paine National Park covering the Valle del Francés, Grey Glacier, and the iconic Torres viewpoint. Experience dramatic landscapes of granite towers, turquoise lakes, and diverse Patagonian wildlife including guanacos and condors.
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Magallanes Region

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Trek to the base of the iconic Torres del Paine granite towers at sunrise. The 4-hour round trip hike from Refugio Las Torres rewards you with a breathtaking view of the three towering peaks reflected in the glacial lagoon below, especially magical in the golden morning light.
experiences.location: Refugio Las Torres, Eastern Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition
experiences.description: Paddle through the icy waters of Lago Grey alongside massive floating icebergs calved from the Grey Glacier. A guided kayaking tour offers an intimate perspective of the glacier's towering blue ice walls and the raw, untouched wilderness of Patagonia that few visitors experience.
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Western Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Day Trek
experiences.description: Hike through the stunning Valle del Francés, a glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers, waterfalls, and the dramatic Cuernos del Paine peaks. The trail offers some of the most diverse and awe-inspiring scenery in all of Patagonia, with frequent sightings of Andean condors soaring overhead.
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Central Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Patagonian Asado and Stargazing Night
experiences.description: End your trekking days with an authentic Patagonian asado (traditional barbecue) featuring slow-roasted lamb cooked over an open fire, paired with Chilean Carménère wine. After dinner, join a guided stargazing session under some of the clearest, most unpolluted skies in the Southern Hemisphere.
experiences.location: Lago Pehoé area, Central Torres del Paine
